Scoped to src/review/anthropic.ts, the one file this case concerns. make-diffs.mjs's `origin/<ref>` form can only address a branch tip, not an arbitrary historical sha -- so this diffs main against the branch's CURRENT tip (979bf81d841ee32ea50826a85b5aa8e8b33c98b4 at the time this case was built), not the exact byte-identical pass-1 (624ef6c09b201b98a4d963942726a2652cfb5ba3) / pass-3 (87101960f98abf2ed29c946c20929f1ec964b56c) snapshots the original two review passes saw. This is disclosed rather than hidden because it matters: verified directly in the same pass that built this case, headersFor in src/review/anthropic.ts is unchanged, byte-for-byte, all the way from 624ef6c through the current tip -- the omission this case tests for is present at every one of those points, so the substitution does not change what the diff demonstrates, only which exact commit it is pinned to.

verifiedShas.reVerifiedNote: Both pass1 and pass3 shas re-resolved and re-read directly in this pass, ahead of PR #5's planned closure and the possible deletion of s26/subscription-oauth-locally. src/review/anthropic.ts's headersFor at both shas is still byte-for-byte identical to the version already quoted in subject.md and shown in diff.txt -- confirmed again, not assumed from the earlier pass's record. These shas are recorded here as PROVENANCE ONLY: make-diffs.mjs (read directly in this pass) hardcodes an `origin/<ref>` prefix on both base and head and cannot resolve a raw sha, so they cannot be substituted into base/head to regenerate diff.txt, either before or after the branch is deleted. diff.txt, already committed alongside this file, is the durable artifact this case actually depends on. base/head above will stop resolving once s26/subscription-oauth-locally is deleted; a future full-corpus run of make-diffs.mjs will then fail (not corrupt) this one case -- its existing diff.txt is untouched by that failure, since make-diffs.mjs only overwrites a case's diff.txt on a successful git diff, never on a failed one. NOT established in this or any prior pass: whether the pass1/pass3 commit objects themselves (624ef6c.../8710196...) are reachable from any ref other than s26/subscription-oauth-locally -- no merge or preserving ref onto either sha was found. Treat these two shas as a record of what WAS independently verified, twice, not as a claim that they remain independently re-checkable after the branch is gone.
